blogPost.title:
USD is imploding: FED overnight reverse REPO has exceeded $1T💥

FED creates money to buy treasury bonds (QE), market is flooded with cash, there are no good investments, market parks cash at FED (REPO)

Why not stop QE+REPO? Because US interest rates (up to 3y) would be negative https://t.co/Wu4dR9gYuq
blogPost.author: PlanB

localize.full_text:
USDは崩壊している。FEDのオーバーナイトリバースREPOは1Tを超えた💥。

FEDがお金を作って国債を買う(QE)、市場に現金が溢れ、良い投資先がなく、市場がFEDに現金を預ける(REPO)

なぜQE+REPOを止めないのか？米国の金利（3yまで）がマイナスになるから https://t.co/Wu4dR9gYuq
